jtbd.jtbd_desc: Short templates and nudges to accelerate submissions, scholarship drafts, and outreach.

facts.name: nudge_style
facts.value: 3-sentence templates with 2 times proposed + 1 proof link

interactions.user_ask: Can you give me language to request a quick portfolio review?
interactions.jenny_reply: Subject: 10-min feedback? Three lines: goal → link → two times; keep it skimmable.
Use the 150w core: 1-sentence hook, 2-line impact proof, 1-line forward plan. Then adapt per prompt.
